summary: Full 14-image contact and five native images reviewed. No new broad facial collapse observed. B200 still has skin-like neck patches and roughened boundaries on training examples; the three new held-out portraits do not acquire clerical collars. Pixel improvements reported separately by root do not establish collar structure or photographic quality.
limits: Small fixed panel. Contact-level coherence does not establish native photographic quality, identity preservation or distributional diversity. Held-out cases remain excluded from training.
